title: 2023 Topps Holiday #H188 Oscar Gonzalez Cleveland Guardians Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2023 Topps Holiday trading card featuring Oscar Gonzalez, a rookie player for the Cleveland Guardians in Major League Baseball. This card, designated as #H188, is a part of the base set manufactured by Topps for the 2023 season. It is a non-autographed card that is ideal for collectors and fans of baseball memorabilia, especially those interested in rookie cards. This card showcases the young talent of Oscar Gonzalez in his rookie year, making it a valuable addition to any sports trading card collection.
